# theodore-js

> A React content-editable component for consistent, customizable emoji rendering across browsers.

theodore-js replaces native emoji characters with application-provided React elements while preserving editing behavior. It supports custom emoji renderers, TypeScript, controlled editor state, undo history, and inline autocomplete suggestions.
